Founded by primary-care–trained providers, we prioritize long-term relationships, transparent pricing, honest communication, and genuine, evidence-based care. We see our role not just as clinicians, but as educators. That’s why we’ve built one of the most comprehensive service libraries in New England, an encyclopedia of aesthetics designed to answer patient questions before they even walk in the door. Our goal is to empower you with knowledge so you feel informed, confident, and supported at every step. And when the best choice for your goals happens to be outside our clinic, we will tell you that. We routinely recommend trusted colleagues and facilities when we know it’s in a patient’s best interest. Because at PM Aesthetics, it’s never about a quick sale, it’s about earning your trust for the long term. Because we’re locally owned, our horizon is generational, not quarterly. Our name and reputation are on every chart, so we’re building a multigenerational medical practice rooted in long-term relationships. While venture- or private-equity models often plan a 3–5-year exit, our aim is a lifelong connection with patients who value continuity, trust, and care that endures. The PM Aesthetics Difference 1. A Philosophy of Exclusivity and Trust At PM Aesthetics, we have chosen a different path for growth, one built entirely on trust, word of mouth, and patient referrals. Every person who comes to us does so intentionally, confident in our reputation for expertise and care. This allows us to devote our full attention to you and to the relationship we’re building together. 2. Transparent Pricing and Honest Guidance We believe clarity builds confidence. Every treatment at PM Aesthetics comes with transparent, upfront pricing, no hidden fees, no bait-and-switch tactics, no staff commissions and no pressure to purchase more than you need. Because of our medical background, our priority is recommending only what is appropriate and safe. If another facility is better suited for your needs, we’ll point you there without hesitation. 3. Advanced Training & Expertise Our providers undergo quarterly advanced training with leading experts to stay at the forefront of aesthetic medicine. This ensures that every Botox injection, dermal filler treatment, facial, or laser procedure is performed with the highest level of precision and safety. For our patients, this means natural, refined results that never feel overdone, results that stand the test of time. Our team is highly trained across every service we offer — from Botox and Xeomin to advanced fillers, facials, and laser treatments — ensuring precision and artistry at every step. 4. Curated Memberships Our membership program is the most curated and comprehensive in New England. Designed for discerning patients who value consistency and long-term care, membership includes: Preferential pricing across treatments Exclusive access to events and rewards 24/7 concierge communication Ongoing benefits that reward loyalty ​ This model ensures our patients never have to chase promotions, they receive consistent value every month. 5. Results That Speak for Themselves 84% of new consults at PM Aesthetics move forward with treatment , a reflection of the trust our patients feel after learning about our transparent pricing, evidence-based services, and individualized care. Our average new patient is just 34 years old , almost a decade younger than the industry norm, proving that we are the trusted starting point for first-time clients seeking a partner in aesthetics. 6. A Warm, Elegant Experience Our clinic in Bedford, NH was designed to combine the comfort of a luxury space with the clinical excellence of a medical practice. Every visit is guided by integrity, compassion, and a focus on your long-term well-being. Ethical Care Charter Clinical oversight & safety. Clear scope-of-practice, on-site medical oversight, emergency protocols, and documented adverse-event reporting/after-hours escalation Patient-first, not promo-first. We do not run ads or discounts. Care plans are built for you, not for campaigns or quotas. Transparent pricing. All pricing is public with no gatekeeping or in-office surprises. Minimums, deposits, and fees are disclosed upfront. No commissions. Providers are never incentivized to sell. Recommendations reflect medical appropriateness, safety, and your goals. Evidence-based medicine. We offer proven treatments only, no experimental services. Techniques and protocols are updated through rigorous, quarterly training. Informed consent & realistic outcomes. Risks, benefits, alternatives, and timelines are explained in plain language before any treatment. Continuity & quality assurance. Complimentary 2-week toxin follow-ups; touch-ups are free when the provider-recommended dose was given. Every result is reviewed for symmetry and safety. Privacy, protected. Locally owned; no private equity or holding company. We never sell your data. Information is shared only to deliver care (e.g., pharmacy, your clinician), handle emergencies, or manage delinquent accounts. Fair access to time. Clear 24-hour reschedule/no-show policies protect provider time and appointment availability for all patients. Ethical reviews & recognition. We never buy or incentivize reviews or votes and do not participate in pay-to-play award programs. Photo & record consent. Images are used only with explicit permission and stored securely. We will never use your photos in marketing materials without explicit permission. Referral integrity. If a colleague or different setting is better for your needs, we’ll tell you, and help you get there. Respect & inclusion. We provide safe, welcoming care to every person, without discrimination. Accessibility accommodations are available on request. Language services available upon request. Our Top Services at PM Aesthetics Expert Care and Proven Results Lip Filler Enhance your natural beauty with subtle, balanced lip volume and definition. Our licensed professionals use premium dermal fillers to restore fullness, smooth fine lines, and create a naturally youthful look tailored to your unique features. Learn More Botox Smooth wrinkles and soften expression lines with precise Botox or Xeomin treatments. Our experts target specific muscles to refresh your appearance while preserving natural facial expressions and creating a balanced, youthful look. Learn More Lip Flip Achieve a subtle lift of the upper lip without adding volume. Using Botox, the Lip Flip enhances your smile, creating a naturally youthful, balanced appearance that complements other lip treatments for a harmonious result. Learn More VI Peel This chemical peel gently resurfaces the skin to improve texture, tone, and clarity. Ideal for addressing fine lines, acne scars, sun damage, and pigmentation issues, it leaves your complexion refreshed, radiant, and rejuvenated. Learn More RF Microneedling Combine microneedling with radiofrequency energy to stimulate collagen production and tighten the skin. This minimally invasive treatment improves texture, reduces wrinkles, and rejuvenates the face, neck, or body. Learn More Trilift A non-surgical thread lift designed to gently lift and support sagging skin. Trilift enhances facial contours, smooths wrinkles, and provides natural-looking results, leaving you with a refreshed, youthful, and balanced appearance. Learn More Your Partner for Years to Come At PM Aesthetics, we believe the best outcomes come from relationships, not transactions. That’s why our team is focused on creating lifelong connections with our patients, relationships built on mutual trust, respect, and shared values. ​ Our staff reflects the community we serve: passionate, health-conscious, and deeply committed to self-care and confidence. Many of our providers are on their own personal aesthetics and wellness journeys, which allows them to connect with clients as true peers who understand both the excitement and the vulnerability that can come with pursuing aesthetic care. ​ When you choose PM Aesthetics, you’re not entering a cycle of one-time promotions or rushed appointments, you’re joining a community of like-minded individuals who value transparency, long-term wellness, and results that feel natural and personal. Our goal is to walk beside you throughout your journey, whether you’re beginning your first treatment in your 30s, enhancing your results in your 40s, or maintaining your glow for decades to come. ​ For us, every consultation, every membership, and every treatment plan is an opportunity to build a relationship that grows over time. We want our patients to feel they have a trusted partner in confidence, health, and beauty, not just for today, but for years ahead. What Our Clients Say Absolutely love this med spa! View Our Services What Our Clients Say Getting Married? Start Here. Your wedding day results depend almost entirely on when you start. Most brides begin too late for the treatments that make the biggest difference. The treatments that lift, tighten, and remodel, Ultherapy, TriLift, RF Microneedling, require months to develop fully. Botox and filler need time to settle and be adjusted before your day. Even surface treatments like chemical peels have optimal timing windows for photos. Here's the short version of what the timeline looks like: 12 months out — Ultherapy, TriLift, foundational lifting and collagen remodeling. Start now if your wedding is this fall. 6 months out — RF Microneedling series, IPL, dermal filler. Results need time to build and settle. 3 months out — Botox, Xeomin, lip filler. Especially critical for first-time patients who need adjustment time. 6 weeks out — VI Peel, DiamondGlow, SaltFacial. Skin at its clearest for photos. 2 weeks out — Toxin touch-up only. Nothing new or unfamiliar this close to the date. Wedding week — Nothing new. You're ready.
